tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: list-notebooks
tools.description: List every OneNote notebook the signed-in account can open, including shared ones.

tools.name: get-notebook
tools.description: Get one OneNote notebook by id, with its name, sharing state, and web URL.

notebookId.description: Notebook id, as returned by list-notebooks.

tools.name: create-notebook
tools.description: Create a new OneNote notebook. Names may not contain ? * \ / : < > | ' " # and are limited to 50 characters.

displayName.description: Notebook name. Max 50 characters; ? * \ / : < > | ' " # are not allowed.

tools.name: list-sections
tools.description: List OneNote sections. Scoped to one notebook when notebookId is given, this returns only that notebook's top-level sections — sections nested inside a section group are not included. Omit notebookId to list every section the account can reach, section groups included.

notebookId.description: Optional notebook id from list-notebooks. Returns only that notebook's top-level sections — sections inside a section group are not included. Omit to list sections across all notebooks, including ones inside section groups.

tools.name: create-section
tools.description: Create a section inside a OneNote notebook. Names may not contain ? * \ / : < > | ' " # and are limited to 50 characters.

parentNotebookId.description: Id of the notebook to create the section in, from list-notebooks. Also accepted as notebookId.

displayName.description: Section name. Max 50 characters; ? * \ / : < > | ' " # are not allowed.

tools.name: list-section-groups
tools.description: List OneNote section groups — the folders that hold sections inside a notebook. Scoped to one notebook when notebookId is given.

notebookId.description: Optional notebook id from list-notebooks. Omit to list section groups across all notebooks.

tools.name: list-pages
tools.description: List OneNote pages, newest first. Scoped to one section when sectionId is given, otherwise across every notebook. Returns metadata only — use get-page-content to read a page.

sectionId.description: Optional section id from list-sections. Omit to list recent pages across all notebooks.

top.description: Maximum pages to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 100.

tools.name: get-page
tools.description: Get one OneNote page by id: its title, timestamps, position, and parent section. Use get-page-content to read the page body.

pageId.description: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

tools.name: get-page-content
tools.description: Read the body of a OneNote page. Returns markdown by default. Set includeIDs to get the element ids that append-to-page and replace-page-content can target — that always returns HTML, because markdown cannot carry the ids.

pageId.description: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to markdown. Forced to html when includeIDs is set.

includeIDs.description: Include OneNote data-id attributes so individual elements can be targeted for editing. Implies format: html.

tools.name: create-page
tools.description: Create a OneNote page in a section. Content is markdown by default and is converted to the HTML OneNote stores.

parentSectionId.description: Id of the section to create the page in, from list-sections. Also accepted as sectionId.

title.description: Page title. OneNote stores this as the page's <title> element — there is no separate title field.

content.description: Page body, in markdown unless contentFormat says otherwise.

contentFormat.description: Format of `content`. Defaults to markdown. Use html to pass OneNote markup through unchanged.

tools.name: delete-page
tools.description: Delete a OneNote page. The page goes to the notebook recycle bin, but this cannot be undone from here.

pageId.description: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

tools.name: copy-page-to-section
tools.description: Copy a OneNote page into another section, including across notebooks. Waits for the copy to finish and returns the new page id.

pageId.description: Id of the page to copy, from list-pages or search-pages.

destinationSectionId.description: Id of the section to copy the page into, from list-sections.

tools.name: append-to-page
tools.description: Add content to an existing OneNote page without removing anything. Appends to the end of the page by default; pass a target element id from get-page-content (includeIDs: true) to add next to a specific element.

pageId.description: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

content.description: Content to add, in markdown unless contentFormat says otherwise.

target.description: Where to add the content: "body" (default), or a data-id from get-page-content with includeIDs: true.

position.description: Whether the content goes after (default) or before the target.

tools.name: replace-page-content
tools.description: Replace the content of a OneNote page, or just its title. This overwrites what was there and cannot be undone — use append-to-page to add without removing.

pageId.description: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

content.description: Replacement content, in markdown unless contentFormat says otherwise. When target is "title", this is plain text.

contentFormat.description: Format of `content`. Defaults to markdown. Ignored when target is "title".

target.description: What to replace: "body" (default), "title", or a data-id from get-page-content with includeIDs: true.

tools.name: search-pages
tools.description: Search OneNote pages by text. Results may not be exhaustive — OneNote search coverage varies by account type, and this falls back to matching page titles when full-text search is unavailable. Use list-pages to browse a section reliably.

query.description: Text to search for. Pass the literal text, not a pre-encoded string.

top.description: Maximum pages to return. Defaults to 25, capped at 100.
